name: Two-way check valve
function: A plug set in the tubing hanger profile that holds pressure from both directions so that the tree and connection above it can be pressure tested against a closed well.

tabs.overview: Same profile and running tool as the back pressure valve. Installed for the tree test, then replaced by a BPV or removed once the tree is tested and the well is ready to be opened.
tabs.engineering: API 6A; rated to the tree test pressure.
tabs.safety: The TWC must be pulled before the well is opened to flow; a forgotten TWC is a known cause of a dead well after tree installation.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
